subject: Harness T5: scorer + run.py CLI + report + SCORECARD section
description:
Python stdlib-only (embeddable py312embed, FULL PATH; note-mqgz977tbqe). Reads the probe runner's results.jsonl {arm,conv_id,qid,category,question,gold,predicted}.

scorer.py — HEADLINE metric = LLM-judge accuracy (the field's metric, comparable to Mem0 92.5/94.4 + Zep 91.6/94.8). Port official judge prompts: LongMemEval ships them in its repo; LoCoMo uses a standard correctness judge. One claude -p per (probe,arm) → correct/incorrect; abstention questions scored correct-iff-refused. Overall + per-category accuracy per arm. SECONDARY (LoCoMo): token-level F1 (Porter-stemmed, deterministic) as a diagnostic. gold is used ONLY here (scoring) — never in the runner.

run.py — CLI: load(datasets.py) → ingest(ConversationIngester) → probe(probe_runner) → score(scorer). Args: --benchmark locomo|longmemeval, --data-dir <abs>, --arms our-way,search,cold, --daemon, --workspace-root <abs>, --model, --limit N. Idempotent/resumable per conversation (checkpoint).

report.{json,md} — per-arm overall + per-category accuracy vs the competitor bar.

bench/SCORECARD.md — add a "LoCoMo / LongMemEval (their test, our DAG read)" section with the SOUND framing (note-mqgvsc4wtct + plan F): present as a CONTRAST axis (retrieval-time recall = the field's metric); show 3 arms (our-way DAG read / search retrieval-time control / cold floor) beside the competitor bar (Mem0 92.5/94.4, Zep 91.6/94.8). State precisely: our-way answers from frozen context_deps via /task/context, where relevance was decided ONCE at write-time by a blind judge — not re-embedded per query. Show cold (rigging guard). Mark the Zonoid full-dataset number PENDING a real run; document the fixture proof-of-mechanism (multi-hop q2: our-way ✓ / search ✗ / cold ✗). Do NOT overclaim — disclose that candidate-gen is still embedding under the hood (we move WHEN, not whether) and that LoCoMo scoring is vendor-disputed.

Verify: run scorer on the fixture run output (or a small synthetic results.jsonl) — accuracy + F1 compute, report renders. Scope: scorer.py + run.py + report + SCORECARD section only. Commit on the attempt branch.
